name: Moses Brown Sports Camps
operator_name: Moses Brown School (Moses Brown Auxiliary Services)
description_short: Weekly sports day camps at Moses Brown School in Providence, covering baseball, lacrosse, field hockey, flag football, basketball, soccer, softball, squash, tennis, track and field, and volleyball. Most programs are half-day mornings (8:30 a.m.-12:00 p.m.). Soccer and basketball also offer full days until 3:00 p.m.

warnings: Filled zip 02906 from the US Census geocoder (250 LLOYD AVE, PROVIDENCE, RI, 02906)

The page doesn't state a year. The calendar matches summer 2026 (June 15 falls on a Monday, and there's no camp June 19, Juneteenth). That season has already passed as of 2026-10-13. Details for 2027 have not been posted.
Several programs list a week starting 'July 22', which is a Wednesday in 2026. It is probably a typo for July 20. It is recorded as stated, with no end date.

End dates are inferred as the Friday of each listed week, or Thursday for the June 15 week. The June 29 week says 'no camp July 4', but July 4, 2026 is a Saturday, so it's unclear which day is off. Its end date is left blank.
Prices for the 4-day weeks (June 15, June 29) are 'prorated in the registration process', so those session prices are left blank. The exception is basketball, whose June prices are stated.
The track and field waitlist status for the June 22 week refers to the past season.
Lunch, extended day, financial aid and cancellation details are on separate pages that were not included in this source.
8 sessions without full dates were left out
